title: closure-ordinal
description: The least ordinal at which iterating the settling endofunctor from the initial state reaches a fixpoint - the stage where the knowledge-least valuation settles. Generated by reading off when the settling iteration stabilizes.

endofunctor.description: the F_U whose transfinite iteration is being closed

initialState.description: the starting state E_0 from which iteration begins

leastFixpointStage.description: kappa is the least ordinal tau with F_U^(tau+1)(E_0) = F_U^tau(E_0); kappa = infinity if no such ordinal exists in the ambient universe

boundedByObjectClass.description: by Knaster-Tarski plus transfinite induction, kappa <= |PrFib|^+, the successor cardinal of the 2-category's object class, in any fixed ambient
